factors_b.kind: roster change (new in-game leader + new player + new coach)
factors_b.summary: Aurora rebuilt around their Turkish core (XANTARES, woxic, Wicadia) in July 2026: MAJ3R stepped down and soulfly was benched on 2 July, Jimpphat signed from MOUZ on 3 July, ash became head coach on 3 July and kyxsan joined from Falcons as in-game leader on 8 July. That is about 100 days before the day-3 decider, and the rebuilt five has since reached the StarSeries Fall final (HLTV news, 19 Sep 2026) and sits 5th on Valve's official standings. Treat the churn as a tiebreak on a close match, not as evidence of a broken team.
factors_b.counter_evidence: Aurora beat Ninjas in Pyjamas 2-0 on 15 Oct 2026 (Cache 13-9, Dust2 13-7) two days after the 9z loss, with Wicadia on a 1.65 rating, and HLTV lists them 6th in the world on 12 Oct 2026.
